visual_overrides.core_identity: An apparently decorative rug animated into a flexible constricting sheet with no face or limbs.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Large rectangular textile lifting in a curling wave while retaining clear rug corners and edges.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Flat woven rectangle capable of bending, rolling, and wrapping while remaining unmistakably a rug.
visual_overrides.surface: Broad simple geometric or heraldic pattern with large colorable areas and sparse fringe.
